verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's SQL engine supports bulk operations natively — bulk/async inserts, INSERT SELECT with parallelized threads, materialized views for pre-aggregation, and clickhouse-local for bulk file processing, all confirmed by hands-on probes running real multi-row SQL roundtrips keylessly. Community evidence corroborates billions of rows processed daily and bulk analytical workloads at scale. missing for 10: no explicit evidence of bulk UPDATE/DELETE across many rows (community notes limited DELETE support), and no dedicated AI-native bulk-operation API beyond standard SQL/MCP tool-call semantics.
